title: Request feed: paginated request list per hook
description: Implement request feed view in app.js. Show paginated list of captured requests for a hook with method badges, path, size, source IP, relative time. Load more pagination, back navigation to hook list.
acceptance_criteria: Request rows show method badge (color-coded), path, size, source IP, relative time
Click request navigates to detail view
Hook name and ingestion URL in header
Empty state and 'Showing X of Y' indicator
